correction.original_test: PERSIST mean RMSE < NATIONAL_ONLY mean RMSE
correction.correct_reading: This tests full 100% territorial persistence, not the existence of partial reusable territorial information.

territorial_memory_strength_diagnostic.method: Because forecast shares are linear in lambda for lambda*territory_prior + (1-lambda)*national_prior, MSE is exactly quadratic in lambda. The oracle lambda for each fold is therefore exactly recoverable from the three frozen scores at lambda=0,0.5,1.
territorial_memory_strength_diagnostic.interpretation: The amount of territorial persistence is non-stationary across the two observed transitions. A lambda learned on 2011->2016 would not improve 2021 over NATIONAL_ONLY.

forecastability_conclusion.why_not_yet: Only one earlier transition exists before the 2016 fold, so ex-ante calibration of transition uncertainty and stability of territorial-memory strength cannot be established without 2007 or earlier data.
forecastability_conclusion.next_data_unlock: 2007, ideally 2002, enabling rolling-origin training/calibration before 2011, 2016 and 2021.
